subject: Playbook alignment: SE + ML intro for evaluation & close timeline
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ramirez <elenar@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Playbook alignment: SE + ML intro for evaluation & close timeline

Hi Elena — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for the productive discovery last week. I wanted to introduce the technical owners from our side so we can align on a short mutual action plan (MAP) and the evaluation timeline you mentioned — your note about a potential December go/no-go is helpful context.

Karthik Iyer — Solutions Engineer (technical lead for the evaluation, demo & integration).
Marcus Lin — ML Engineer (model behavior, eval criteria, dataset guidance).

Goal: get a 45–60m technical kickoff this week to:
- Align roles and success criteria for the evaluation (latency, P95, cost targets, failure modes)
- Agree on dataset & privacy constraints (what you can share, anonymization)
- Walk through the MAP milestones to reach a decision by mid-December

I attached a one-page MAP draft (redwood_map_v0.1.pdf) with proposed milestones and owners; please treat it as a starting point. Proposed slots: Tue Oct 6 10:00–10:45 PT or Wed Oct 7 14:00–14:45 PT. If neither work, propose two windows that suit your engineering lead.

Deliverables we’ll bring to the meeting: draft eval plan, checklist for network/security requirements, and a short list of what we’ll need from Atlas for a valid run.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the technical handshake in place.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Director, Solutions Partnerships
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_map_v0.1.pdf (PDF, 58 KB)
From: Elena Ramirez <elenar@atlashealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Barnes <tbarnes@atlashealth.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Playbook alignment: SE + ML intro for evaluation & close timeline

Thanks Soojin — thanks for the intro and the draft MAP. I’m looping in our engineering lead Tom Barnes (he’ll drive the hands-on work on our side).

Both time slots look doable for us; Tom prefers Tue Oct 6 10:00 PT. High-level confirmation of timelines: we’re targeting an internal decision by the week of Dec 14 so that procurement and legal can finish by year-end. The primary success criteria for Atlas: throughput to support 50 reqs/s with <150ms P95 (on a 4k prompt distribution) and no PHI leakage — we’ll need to validate on a de-identified sample.

We’ll bring: a representative eval dataset (we’ll aim to share a 500-row de-identified extract ahead of the call) and a short list of security requirements. If you have a template NDA or a one-page data handling blurb, please send it.

—Elena
Elena Ramirez
Director of Engineering, Atlas Health
external: +1 415 555 0198
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ramirez <elenar@atlashealth.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 07:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Playbook alignment: SE + ML intro for evaluation & close timeline

Elena / team — thanks for confirming, happy to own the hands-on tech coordination. Confirming Tue Oct 6 10:00 PT (I’ll send a calendar invite). Agenda I propose (45 min):
1) 10m intros & roles (owners, escalations)
2) 15m eval scope: dataset shape, expected traffic profile, and failure modes to test
3) 10m infra & security: network connectivity options (VPC peering vs. temporary SFTP), data handling, and SSO/SAML questions
4) 10m next steps / MAP milestone dates (deliverables & who’s responsible)

Ask for prep from Atlas: brief schema sample and a short paragraph on de-identification approach (CSV is fine). If you can drop the sample to the Drive link below before EOD Monday it will speed the call.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-redwood-map
Quick security doc: https://redwood-internal.example.com/sec-overview (summary only; we’ll provide SOC2 artifacts under NDA).

I’ll bring a pared-down eval checklist and notes on expected resource sizing for the 50 req/s target so we can align on quant and ops impact during the call.

Karthik
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments referenced: eval_checklist_short.pdf (will attach in calendar invite)
From: Elena Ramirez <elenar@atlashealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Barnes <tbarnes@atlashealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Playbook alignment: SE + ML intro for evaluation & close timeline

Perfect — confirmed for Tue Oct 6 10:00 PT. I’ve uploaded a de-identified sample (eval_dataset_sample.csv) to the Drive link and added a short note about our anonymization steps. Tom will attend and owns the dataset handoff.

Also: procurement asked if we can get a ballpark MLP (total cost estimate) for the evaluation run (2–3 weeks) so we can set expectations internally; any rough numbers you can share post-call would help. We expect to sign an MSA if the eval looks good.

See you Tuesday.

—Elena
attachments: eval_dataset_sample.csv (CSV, 24 KB); note: will request NDA draft if needed
